nodes.name: Webhook: /shiftfit/publish
nodes.notes: SECURITY: only the ShiftFit gateway (src/server/gateway.ts) may call this, never a browser. Create an n8n Header Auth credential with Name = Authorization and Value = Bearer <AUTOMATION_SECRET> (the same secret set on Netlify) and select it here. The gateway has already checked the manager passcode, re-checked the schedule's rules and rebuilt these events before calling. See docs/N8N_ARCHITECTURE.md, Authentication.

nodes.name: Google Calendar: create/update event
nodes.notes: operation/start/end/recurrence are set FROM the item's own fields (existingEventId from 'Diff vs. previously synced events', recurrence from ShiftFit's publish request — see PublishRecurrence in src/services/automation/contracts.ts). The exact parameter names (operation, eventId, additionalFields.recurrence) depend on your n8n Google Calendar node version — check them against your instance before relying on this; it has never been run live. On error this node carries on (onError: continueRegularOutput), so one rejected event is reported as failed instead of stopping every other shift. Every item reaching this node has a checked $json.recurrence ('Validate request shape' skips events without real dates). Skipped days (EXDATE) are rewritten from 2026-10-06T09:00:00 to 20261006T090000, the only date-time format the calendar standard (RFC 5545) accepts there; sending the dashed form meant holidays would not be skipped. Google Calendar needs the timezone for a repeating event: if your node version has a start/end timezone option, set it to {{ $json.recurrence.timeZone }}.

nodes.name: Webhook: /shiftfit/remove
nodes.notes: Deletes old events for shifts the manager moved or removed, ONLY after the manager confirmed it in ShiftFit. It lives in this same workflow on purpose: n8n keeps workflow static data per workflow, and removal needs the same shiftId -> googleEventId records the publish path writes. Same Header Auth credential as the publish webhook.

nodes.name: Google Calendar: delete event
nodes.notes: Deletes the whole repeating event (every week of that shift). Use the same calendar and Google credential as 'Google Calendar: create/update event'. Carries on after an error so one failure is reported instead of stopping the rest. Never run live yet: check the parameter names against your n8n version.

meta.note: Starting-point template only — not a tested workflow. No real credentials included. See docs/N8N_ARCHITECTURE.md Workflow C. Two webhooks share one workflow: /shiftfit/publish creates or updates events, and /shiftfit/remove deletes old ones the manager confirmed. Both use n8n's own workflow static data for the shiftId->googleEventId records, so a pilot needs no external database. Only the ShiftFit gateway may call either webhook (Header Auth).
